title: nervilia parishiana
intro: Nervilia parishiana, commonly known as the parish's hood orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family, native to China. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Nervilia parishiana include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, making it a potential remedy for pain relief and fever reduction. The bioactive constituents of Nervilia parishiana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
